---
name: Bug report
about: Report reproducible behavior that differs from the documented expectation
title: "bug: "
labels: bug
---

## What happened?

Describe the observed behavior and why it is a problem.

## How can we reproduce it?

Provide the smallest exact commands, inputs, and environment details needed to reproduce
the result. Do not include credentials or private data.

## What did you expect instead?

State the documented or intended behavior.

## Evidence

Include relevant error output, receipt identifiers, or links to public artifacts. Redact
sensitive values.
